versionTitle: 版本一：敦煌藏经洞矿物重彩 × 宋刻本古籍留白风 (Dunhuang Mineral Pigment & Song Woodblock Print)
title: 器物图谱·三只若琛白瓷品字杯
prompt: Masterpiece traditional Chinese mineral pigment illustration on aged Dunhuang hemp-mulberry paper (#D9CBAF warm sand parchment texture), inspired by cave17.e-dunhuang.com and Song Dynasty fine woodblock book art (Lü Jingren editorial aesthetic). Natural ground mineral palette: cinnabar vermilion (#824239), azurite mineral blue-green (#536B66), raw ochre (#9A6B46), and delicate gold-leaf hairlines (#C8A464). Fine iron-wire ink linework (铁线描) with weathered mural patina, museum-grade editorial composition, 1:1 square aspect ratio, at least 45% negative parchment space around a single iconic subject, flat diffused archival lighting, strictly no text, no letters, no watermark, no modern UI. Subject: Three eggshell-thin white porcelain tea cups (若琛杯) arranged in a tight triangle on a dark slotted wooden tea tray, filled with clear golden tea.
